### `MapPool(UF(Pool2D))`
Creates a `MapPool2D` instance with the supplied user function.
```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
}
```

### `operator()`
Calls the `MapPool2D` instance, performing the user function on the input parameters, and stores the result in the output containers.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    skepu::Matrix<int> in(5, 5), out(5, 5);

    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);

    poolSum(out, in);
}
```

### `setPoolSize(int pi, int pj)`
Sets the pool size for the `MapPool2D` instance. Is set to 1 by default in each dimension. Cannot be less than 0. `pi` is the outermost dimension.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
    poolSum.setPoolSize(2, 2);
}
```

### `setPoolSize(int p)`
Calls `setPoolSize(p, p)`.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
    poolSum.setPoolSize(2);
}
```

### `getPoolSize() -> std::tuple<int, int>`
Returns a tuple of the current pool size in each dimension of the `MapPool2D` instance.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
    std::tuple<int, int> poolSizes = poolSum.getPoolSize();
}
```

### `setStride(int si, int sj)`
Sets the stride for the dimensions of the `MapPool2D` instance. Is set to 1 by default in each dimension. Cannot be less than 0. `si` is the outermost dimension.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
    poolSum.setStride(2, 2);
}
```

### `setStride(int s)`
Calls `setStride(s, s)`.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
    poolSum.setStride(2);
}
```

### `getStride() -> std::tuple<int, int>`
Returns a tuple of the current stride in each dimension of the `MapPool2D` instance.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;

int main()
```

### `setPoolSizeAndStride(int pi, int pj)`
Calls `setPoolSize(pi, pj)` and `setStride(pi, pj)`.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
    poolSum.setPoolSizeAndStride(2, 2);
}
```

### `setPoolSizeAndStride(int p)`
Calls `setPoolSize(p)` and `setStride(p)`.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Pool2D<int> p)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p.si; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < p.sj; ++j)
            val += p(i, j);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto poolSum = skepu::MapPool(sum);
    poolSum.setPoolSizeAndStride(2);
}
```
